_comment: Narrow, EXPIRING exceptions for `npm audit --audit-level=high`, enforced by .github/scripts/npm-audit-allowlist.mjs in CI. Add an entry only for an advisory with NO patched release, after confirming it does not reach the shipped bundle; always set an expiry so it is re-reviewed. An expired entry fails CI until it is removed (fixed upstream) or renewed with a fresh review.

bundle._comment: Read by .github/scripts/npm-audit-allowlist-bundle-check.mjs. Everything a browser can run must be explained: a chunk of the project's own Vite build (judged from Rollup's resolved module graph), one of Vite's own helper modules, a virtual module listed here, or a repository-authored script pinned here. 'project' is the path from the repository root. An inline pin is the sha256 of the script body with each line trimmed and empty lines dropped; a 'pattern' pin is an anchored regular expression for generated stubs. The check prints the sha256 of any unpinned inline script so a reviewed change can be re-pinned deliberately.

trustedVirtualModules.reason: Generated at build time by docs-site/src/vite-plugins/repo-index.ts from files in this repository (notebook list, Cedar policy text, documentation titles); it contains data, not code from any npm package.

firstPartyScripts.reason: Hand-written embeddable chat web component (frontend/public/agentcore-chat-v1.js), served verbatim from public/ for customers to drop into their own pages; plain DOM code with no dependencies.

The legacy hash-router redirect shim in docs-site/index.html (the <!-- hash-shim --> block that maps '/#/security' style URLs to their new paths), as Vite emits it into every prerendered page; plain DOM code with no dependencies.

The one-line redirect stub docs-site/scripts/prerender.mjs writes for every moved route (redirectStub); the target is a path under the GitHub Pages base made of letter/digit/dash/underscore segments each ending in '/', so no dot segment can leave the base.
